# Sri Sri Wellbeing Chennai

Sri Sri Wellbeing Chennai is an Ayurveda and holistic wellness centre in Kilpauk, Chennai.

Primary location: Mruthunjaya Ayur, New Avadi Road, Alagappa Nagar, Kilpauk, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600010.
